$comment: Machine-readable source declarations. Runtime enforcement is each skill's preflight: connector registration and session tool availability are different surfaces, so every run probes by tool search. 'required' = the skill's core promise breaks without it (run is partial and must say so); 'preferred' = degrades acceptably via the protocols in the SKILL.md. The M365 connector needs the organization's admin to approve it, cell-level Excel reads aren't documented, and its write tools are off until an admin enables them and work on whole files only (no in-place Excel editing) — the pending-review write degrades to an export sheet when absent.

m365-sharepoint-read.degradedFallback: none for build-target-list — the media log IS the candidate pool; without it the chain stops after analyze-release and says so

m365-outlook-read.degradedFallback: Pass B loses its primary source; open-web sweep (Bluesky public feed + web) still runs, framed as partial

google-drive.degradedFallback: a Google Sheet log is read only in a session a person started; the pending-review rows go on their own sheet in the export if the new Sheet cannot be created

local-files.degradedFallback: none needed: a file log and the suite's own list are read and written locally, unattended runs included

m365-sharepoint-write.degradedFallback: approved discoveries land on their own sheet in the export with a 'paste into your review file' note; the chain never stalls on this

archive-files.connector: the gameplan root's own files, through scripts/archive.py
archive-files.degradedFallback: no project folder, or the script fails: pitch-history check becomes a named gap, finalize saves nothing durable (operator is told before curation begins), history questions and /outcomes unavailable

newsdata.connector: Newsdata archive API (NEWSDATA_API_KEY in the environment; Claude Code only, the Claude app has nowhere to keep a key)
newsdata.degradedFallback: media lists come from web search alone, said as a named gap

web.degradedFallback: discovery Pass A, the open-web half of Pass B, pitch-angle notes, and outcome search all become named gaps

analyze-release.note: pure analysis of provided text; touches nothing

reporter-list.note: requires exactly the source media_log.source names (m365, google, file, suite); the only reader of the media log and the only writer of pending review; a failed write hands the rows back for the export

build-target-list.note: reads the log through reporter-list; without the archive, pitch history is a named gap, never silently skipped

discover-reporters.note: zero findings is a fine answer; absent sources are named, not papered over

curate-and-archive.note: finalize with no project folder must warn BEFORE curation starts, not at save time; the pending-review write goes through reporter-list

media-list-run.note: reads and writes the reporter list only through reporter-list; no list at all starts the suite's own
